_comment: Upstream repository to sync sing-box rule files from. The workflow does `git clone --sparse` of this repo/branch/path into `upstream_checkout_dir` BEFORE running the script; the script only reads local files.
_cdn_note: cdn_owner/cdn_repo are only used as a fallback — normally the workflow's GITHUB_REPOSITORY env var supplies them automatically. cdn_ref_mode 'tag' links to the exact release tag just created this run; 'branch' always points at cdn_branch (may be briefly stale right after a run, but never 404s).
